main.description: Set the two-factor authentication method for the account. Omit authFactorType to turn 2FA off. Currently only iM8 verification is supported through this endpoint.

password.description: Fresh account-password confirmation, required by native wallet-factor implementations. Never an app password.

authFactorToken.description: Purpose-bound wallet approval for enrollment or removal, required by native wallet-factor implementations.

authFactorType.description: The 2FA method to require at login. Omit to turn 2FA off.

authFactorMode.description: Independent wallet challenge protocol, when supported.

authFactorType.description: The 2FA method now required at login. Absent when 2FA is off.
